blocks.text: BRASILIA — Brazilian President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva will attend the UN Climate Change Conference (COP 31), held November 9-20 in Antalya, Turkey, a government source told AFP on Saturday. The recently reelected leftist leader is a leading figure in global warming discussion. Brazil hosted the previous summit last year in the heart of the Amazon. READ: Trump critic Lula wins reelection in Brazil, securing 4th term Despite the symbolism of holding the talks in the world’s largest tropical rainforest, delegations failed to set binding targets or deadlines for phasing out coal, oil and gas.
